operations.title: The Gaussian endpoint boundary has the wrong spectral growth
operations.statement: For D=-i d/dy on a compact logarithmic interval with finite-dimensional unitary endpoint law f(L)=Uf(0), the spectrum is the finite union lambda_(j,n)=(2 pi n+theta_j)/L and N_D(T)=rLT/(2pi)+O(1). Taking U=(1+J)/sqrt(2) therefore realizes the Gaussian half-rotation self-adjointly and supplies its phase offsets, but its characteristic determinant has linear zero density and cannot equal completed Riemann xi, whose zero count grows as T log T.
operations.scope: Exact no-go for finite-rank, energy-independent endpoint unitaries; does not exclude infinite-rank or energy-dependent prime-coupled boundaries and does not construct a physical relative-chain pushforward.

operations.title: Finite-unitary endpoint Weyl-law hostile test
operations.description: Diagonalize the endpoint unitary, solve the first-order eigenvalue equation exactly, and compare its linear Weyl count with the Riemann-von Mangoldt count.
